preconditions.description: The length of the string and the array of indices must be equal.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(i, int) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: All elements in the indices array must be integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < len(s) for i in indices)
preconditions.description: All indices in the indices array must be within the bounds of the string.

postconditions.description: The length of the returned string is the same as the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value[indices[i]] == s[i] for i in range(len(s)))
postconditions.description: Each character in the input string is placed in the position specified by the corresponding element in the indices array in the returned string.
